checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Non-existent product_uuid on line item must not crash event group creation
checkResults.expectedResult: HTTP 4xx expected (422 with a numeric code). Risk being probed: get_details_for_event_group_line_items does products.find { ... } then dereferences product.id, so an unmatched product would raise NoMethodError on nil and surface as 500. Either way the transaction must roll back and leave zero event_groups rows.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with a line item whose product_uuid decodes to an id with no matching active Product.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx and NOT a 500.
3. Assert no partially-created EventGroup is left behind, since create_line_items runs inside the ActiveRecord::Base.transaction.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser. The decoded product id does not exist, or exists but is not Product.active in this workspace.
checkResults.verdict: server error 500 — a 5xx is always a defect

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Negative and non-numeric quantities must not be silently coerced into a valid event
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx. Documented hazard: the helper uses quantity[:value].to_f, so 'ten'.to_f becomes 0.0 and silently flips is_rate_only to true, while -5 survives as -5.0. A negative or silently rate-only line item must be refused with a numeric error code rather than persisted.
steps: 1. POST /event_groups with two line items: one with quantity value -5 and one with quantity value 'ten'.
2. Assert the response is a controlled 4xx, or if accepted, assert the stored quantities are never negative.
3. GET /event_groups/{{eventGroupUuid}}/get_line_items and inspect the persisted quantity values.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated purchaser; {{productUuid}} and {{productQualityUuid}} are active.

checkResults.scenario: QA_Platform_Cross-tenant product_uuid must not be attachable to an event group
checkResults.expectedResult: No 5xx and no data leak. Expected outcome is HTTP 422 with a numeric error code; the created EventGroup (if any) must carry company_id = Current.workspace.id only and must not expose the foreign product's name or quality params in meta_data.
steps: 1. Obtain a product uuid owned by a different tenant.
2. POST /event_groups as company A referencing that foreign {{productUuid}}.
3. Assert the request is refused or the product is not attached, and no cross-tenant product name leaks in the response body.
checkResults.preconditions: Authenticated as a purchaser of company A. {{productUuid}} is a Product that belongs to company B and is not visible to company A.

steps.title: Add the pricing round
steps.expected: The pricing round (RFQ) is attached to the draft as round 1 of 1, with bidding open 18:20–18:21.
steps.actual: Round 1 (pricing round, RFQ) was attached as Wlpwa3Bw; bidding open 18:20–18:21.

validations.error_message: Quantity should be greater than the Minimum quantity
Price should be less than the Cap price
Please change your price at least by mentioned tick price

configurations.title: RFQ
terms_and_conditions: Your evaluation for this event will depend on Gross Total.

steps.title: Publish the event to the invited vendor
steps.expected: “API_Journey_RFQ_only_1789735854822” goes live — status active — with 1 round attached and the invited vendor able to see it.
steps.actual: “API_Journey_RFQ_only_1789735854822” is now active with 1 round, visible to 1 vendor.

steps.title: Read the event back
steps.expected: Reading the event back shows it active with 1 round and the invited vendor on it.
steps.actual: The event reads back as active with 1 round.

steps.title: Sign in as the vendor
steps.postman: auth › vendor_generate otp, vendor verify otp
steps.expected: A one-time code is sent to amd@gmail.com and, once verified, signs the vendor into the supplier app.
steps.actual: Signed in as the vendor (AMD LTD, amd@gmail.com) — the one-time code was accepted. This user's home company is WE5EWlpa; the bid is placed for the invited WE5aWlpa.

steps.title: Open the pricing round as the vendor
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › trade details
steps.expected: The vendor can open the pricing round and sees the line item (47 KG) to quote on.
steps.actual: The vendor sees 1 line item (47 KG) on the pricing round.

steps.title: Open a bid on the pricing round
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › create bid
steps.expected: A bid is opened for AMD LTD on the pricing round and comes back with its id.
steps.actual: Bid TmdjRFpa was opened on the pricing round for AMD LTD.

steps.title: Price the line item
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › create bid products
steps.expected: The line item is priced at ₹194 per KG for 47 KG — ₹9,118 before tax — and the app accepts it.
steps.actual: Quoted ₹194 per KG for 47 KG — ₹9,118 before tax.

steps.title: Submit the bid
steps.postman: vendor technical and bid › submit bid
steps.expected: The bid is submitted and the app answers success: true.
steps.actual: Bid submitted (the app answered success: true).

steps.title: Wait for the bidding window to close
steps.expected: The bidding window closes at 18:21:44; the run waits for it (plus 8 seconds) before evaluating or awarding.

steps.title: Open an award proposal
steps.expected: An award proposal is opened on the event and comes back with its id.
steps.actual: Award proposal cGRrZGM= was opened on the event.

steps.title: Award the quantity to the vendor
steps.expected: 47 KG of the line item is awarded to AMD LTD on the proposal and the app accepts it.
steps.actual: Awarded 47 KG of the line item to AMD LTD.

steps.title: Read the approval workflow for the award
steps.expected: The app lists the approval workflow that applies to this award, or says there is none.
steps.actual: 2 approval workflows apply; the award goes through UVFaWg== with 2 approvers.

steps.title: Submit the award for approval
steps.expected: The award is submitted into its approval workflow and the app answers success: true.
steps.actual: The award was submitted for approval.

setupSteps.did: Draft cEREY0RY was created with one line item (47 KG).
Round 1 (pricing round, RFQ) was attached as Wlpwa3Bw; bidding open 18:20–18:21.
“API_Journey_RFQ_only_1789735854822” is now active with 1 round, visible to 1 vendor.
The event reads back as active with 1 round.
